svg.title: OpenHarness: coding first, then 44 harnesses across 10 more categories
svg.desc: Coding is the main category, with fourteen supported agents. Below it, harnesses for Design, Engineering, Media, Music, Productivity, Science and Data, Simulation, Games, Research, and Local AI. The full catalog is in the README table.
svg.text: Start with code. Build across disciplines.
14 coding agents · 44 harnesses · one open-source workshop
The agents you already use, together across your machines.
